description: Implementation of the AdbLegacyEndpointObject class, which manages USB endpoint handles and performs asynchronous and synchronous read/write operations using Windows API calls, specifically for legacy USB drivers in the Android development environment.

classes.name: AdbLegacyEndpointObject
classes.description: Manages legacy USB endpoint handles, providing methods for asynchronous and synchronous data transfer, handle creation, and cleanup.

methods.name: AdbLegacyEndpointObject::CommonAsyncReadWrite
methods.description: Performs asynchronous read or write operations on the USB endpoint, using overlapped I/O or IOCTL based on timeout.

methods.name: AdbLegacyEndpointObject::CommonSyncReadWrite
methods.description: Performs synchronous read or write operations on the USB endpoint, waiting for completion.

methods.name: AdbLegacyEndpointObject::CreateHandle
methods.description: Creates and opens a handle to the USB endpoint, returning an ADB handle.

methods.name: AdbLegacyEndpointObject::CloseHandle
methods.description: Closes the USB handle and cleans up resources.
